title: Couscous with pink shrimp and vegetables
blurb: Fluffy couscous tossed with tender shrimp, sweet carrots and courgettes in a light herby broth.
steps: Peel and dice the carrot into small cubes, then dice the courgette to match. Peel and finely chop the onion and garlic.
Heat the olive oil in a wide pan over medium heat and cook the onion and carrot for 8 minutes until softening. Add the garlic and cumin and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the vegetable stock and bring to a simmer, then add the courgette and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the couscous, cover the pan tightly and remove from the heat. Leave to stand for 10 minutes so the couscous absorbs the liquid.
Meanwhile, rinse the shrimp and pat dry. Roughly chop the parsley.
Fluff the couscous with a fork, then stir through the shrimp. Cover and leave for 5 minutes until the shrimp are cooked through.
Squeeze over the lemon juice, scatter with parsley and serve.
